components.title: Lexicon Mastery
components.subtitle: Enhance your verbal intelligence with this curated deck of ten high-impact vocabulary words. Use active recall for maximum retention.

cards.back: Lasting for a very short time; transient, fleeting, or momentary.
To deliberately make something obscure, unclear, or difficult to understand.
Given to sudden and unaccountable changes of mood or behavior; fickle.
Reserved or uncommunicative in speech; saying very little.
Tending to talk a great deal; extremely talkative.
To make less severe, serious, or painful; to alleviate or moderate.
Dealing with things sensibly and realistically based on practical considerations.
A harsh, discordant, and meaningless mixture of loud sounds.
Deviating from what is standard, normal, or expected; peculiar.
To use ambiguous language so as to conceal the truth or avoid committing oneself.

components.title: Active Recall Strategy
components.text: Before flipping a card, try to define the term aloud or use it in an original sentence. Passive reading builds recognition, but active generation builds permanent recall.
